title: 1. Start
summary: List the layers, open a vector table, explore a tehsil STAC collection and make your first API request.

title: 2. Know Your Micro-Watershed
summary: Read the area, basin fields, elevation, terrain and drainage of one MWS, then map its upstream and downstream links.

title: 3. See Water through the Years and Seasons
summary: Follow annual and seasonal rainfall, evapotranspiration and runoff, then read fortnightly water and vegetation values.

title: 4. Analyse Water Storage: Surface Waterbodies
summary: List waterbodies and read their annual and seasonal water-spread areas from 2017–18 to 2024–25.

title: 5. Analyse Agriculture through Time
summary: Read cropping areas and land-cover classes for one micro-watershed from 2017–18 to 2024–25.

title: 6. Know Your Village
summary: Explore population, services, livestock, village survey records and nearby micro-watersheds.
